title: Screen and track genuinely student-accessible <=NT$400 restaurants
question: Among the ten Taipei restaurants in James C. Lin's 500盤 2026 selection, which currently support a realistic one-person meal with an unavoidable bill <=NT$400, and which survivors remain worth tracking after price, portion, friction, and adversarial quality checks?
acceptance_criteria: Classify all ten seed restaurants using current attributable price/minimum-spend evidence.
Count all unavoidable charges and reject cheap-item loopholes that do not constitute a normal solo meal.
For every survivor, verify current menu price, mandatory charges, portion sufficiency, hours, queue/sell-out risk, and ordering friction.
Run a deliberate negative-evidence pass on every survivor.
Separate award-dish availability from restaurant-level affordability.
Preserve exact-price conflicts and freshness uncertainty instead of hiding them.
Maintain only <=NT$400 qualified/borderline restaurants on the active watchlist; retain excluded evidence for recovery.
